categories.definition: The image arrangement, crop, focal hierarchy, or visual balance makes the asset hard to use or review.
categories.reviewer_question: Does the composition clearly present the intended subject and use case?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: state the intended framing, focal subject, and negative space requirement
correction_hint_bridge.avoid_fragment_candidate: ambiguous framing or competing focal subjects

categories.definition: The lighting direction, contrast, exposure, or shadow behavior undermines readability or realism.
dry_run_detection_signals: reviewer notes inconsistent or unusable illumination
categories.reviewer_question: Does the lighting support the asset purpose without hiding important details?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: specify controlled, coherent lighting with readable subject detail
correction_hint_bridge.avoid_fragment_candidate: uncontrolled harsh shadows or mixed lighting

categories.definition: Surface texture, material behavior, or physical plausibility does not look credible enough for review.
dry_run_detection_signals: material realism score below review threshold
reviewer notes plastic, melted, or physically inconsistent surfaces
categories.reviewer_question: Do materials behave like the intended real-world surfaces?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: name the material, finish, texture, and realism expectation
correction_hint_bridge.avoid_fragment_candidate: vague premium material language without physical detail

categories.definition: The asset does not preserve expected product, subject, or brand-critical details.
dry_run_detection_signals: product fidelity score below review threshold
reviewer notes missing, distorted, or substituted product details
categories.reviewer_question: Does the asset preserve the intended product or subject identity?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: lock key product attributes and forbid substitutions
correction_hint_bridge.avoid_fragment_candidate: generic object wording that permits identity drift

categories.definition: The asset is not suitable for the intended commercial, editorial, or reusable production context.
dry_run_detection_signals: commercial fitness score below review threshold
reviewer notes unclear use case, weak polish, or unsuitable presentation
categories.reviewer_question: Can this asset plausibly support the intended commercial or review use?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: state the target use, polish level, and production context
correction_hint_bridge.avoid_fragment_candidate: unclear usage context or low-polish styling

categories.definition: Visible synthetic artifacts, anatomical errors, object corruption, text-like noise, or model hallucinations reduce trust.
dry_run_detection_signals: ai artifact risk score indicates review concern
reviewer notes hallucinated details, distorted edges, or synthetic residue
categories.reviewer_question: Are there AI artifacts that would block reuse or require a new generation attempt?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: require clean edges, plausible anatomy or object geometry, and no text-like noise
correction_hint_bridge.avoid_fragment_candidate: overly ornate detail clusters that invite hallucination

categories.definition: The review pack, registry entry, receipt, attempt result, or dry-run record disagree about identity, class, provenance, or boundary flags.
dry_run_detection_signals: asset id, task id, receipt path, attempt path, or asset_class mismatch
categories.reviewer_question: Do all metadata records prove the same asset identity and non-promotion boundary?

correction_hint_bridge.prompt_constraint_candidate: do not generate; repair metadata binding before any prompt correction
